aboutSection.headline: Turning complex engineering challenges into clean, scalable software
aboutSection.subheadline: I craft resilient system architectures and clean designs, keeping complex software intuitive, performant, and reliable.
aboutSection.highlight1: A decade of experience designing architecture across medical devices, autonomous vehicles, high-speed trading, and microservices.
aboutSection.highlight2: Hands-on architect who loves coding daily in C++, Rust, Python, and modern web frameworks.
aboutSection.highlight3: Designing robust service architectures, APIs, and data models using FastAPI, gRPC, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
aboutSection.highlight4: Architectural mastery from low-level hardware & network protocols (TCP/IP, CAN) to cloud infra (Docker, K8s).
aboutSection.highlight5: Combining strong system design with clear communication, good team vibes, and practical execution.
aboutSection.siteDesignedTag: Designed and built by me, start to finish.

introHighlight.subtitle: My Journey & Philosophy
introHighlight.title: Architecture & Engineering in Action
introHighlight.desc: How over a decade across diverse industries shaped my approach to software architecture and system design.
introHighlight.block1Text: Designing for medical devices, high-frequency trading, and autonomous vehicles taught me how to spot patterns early and architect resilient solutions, no matter the domain.
introHighlight.block2Text: I believe great architecture grows from real code. By staying active in C++, Rust, Python, and TypeScript, my designs remain fast, practical, and fun for developers to build on.
introHighlight.block3Text: From micro-level network protocols (TCP/IP, CAN) to cloud-native platforms with Docker, Kubernetes, and gRPC, I enjoy bringing structure to every layer of the stack.
introHighlight.block4Text: Architecture documents are helpful, but working software is what matters. I focus on turning complex technical requirements into reliable production code.
introHighlight.block5Text: Good architecture is built through teamwork. I bring calm energy, active listening, and a pragmatic focus to turn tricky technical puzzles into smooth implementations.
introHighlight.toolkitDesc: Languages, frameworks, and architecture tools I work with daily.

personalSide.title: Life Beyond the Screen
personalSide.desc: Away from architecture diagrams, life is still about discovery: countries and cultures, long rides, open water, and books that make the world feel bigger.
personalSide.signature: Reading feeds the curiosity. Writing gives it somewhere to go.
personalSide.readerBody: Reading is how I slow down without standing still. A good book opens a different world, challenges an old assumption, and usually leaves behind a question worth carrying.
personalSide.readerCaption: Reading feeds my curiosity. I enjoy discovering new ideas, different perspectives, and stories that stay with me long after the last page.
